name: canilivethere
description: Developer tooling for the CanILiveThere site. The site itself is backend-free and ships NO JavaScript dependencies: every page is plain HTML, CSS and browser ES modules, and nothing under node_modules/ is ever served to a reader. This file exists for developer tooling only: the store tests (npm test, Node's built-in runner, no dependencies), the live-site smoke test (npm run smoke), and a real rendered browser DOM so the site can be opened before publication instead of being reviewed by reading its source. See the 'Inspecting a rendered page' section of README.md.
